replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset while retaining as much variability as possible. The eigenvectors represent the directions of the new feature space, and the eigenvalues represent the magnitude of these directions.
